name: Sound — escape hatches (fixture)
description: Engine fixture exercising every ADR-0033 §5 sound escape hatch on one full-frame piece: the surface enter emits its default whoosh-in through the core kit; the surface exit is MUTED per-motion; the mark draw-on SWAPS its event from tick to pop; the lower-third enter LOCKS a specific sample (core-sting), bypassing kit resolution; audioCues[] carries a manual free-standing outro cue at an absolute fraction and the single ambient BED (segments/bumpers only — this piece declares backgroundFill). Export bakes all of it via the deterministic offline mix; preview schedules the same plan on play.
